The Nemotron 3.5 Bolt model is a compact version of the Nemotron 3.5 Super model, designed to fit a 24 GB NVIDIA GPU for everyday agentic tasks. It has a total of 74 billion parameters, with 9 billion of those being active per token. This information is derived from the context provided in:

- "A compact sibling, [Nemotron 3.5 Bolt](https://ollama.com/library/nemotron-3.5-bolt), distills Super down to 74B parameters (9B active) tuned to fit a 24 GB NVIDIA GPU for everyday agentic tasks, with speculative decoding via its included drafter." [ollama/v0.40.5.md (lines 1-14)](https://github.com/ollama/ollama/releases/tag/v0.40.5) 

Therefore, the Nemotron 3.5 Bolt model has 74 billion total parameters and 9 billion active parameters.
